description:
Pre-assembled; the electric scooter already comes pre-assembled so you won't have to waste time with complicated assembly.

Seat height adjustable for adults and teens; easily to find the perfect position for a comfortable ride

350W Motor with 12 inch wheels; max spped goes about 15-18mph. a pair of air-filled rubber tires with quick-disconnect power lines ensure better traction and easy tire maintenance.

Range; cruise up to 15 miles on a single charge

Handlebar foldable, easy storage or fit in car trunk.

Rear basket included, makes storing and transporting your items easy.

Button Horn – Replaces the traditional bell with a stylish push-button horn.

Key Ignition – Provides added security when parked, preventing theft.
